label: Federally recognized tribe (lower 48 and non-village Alaska)
definition: A tribal government on the Secretary of the Interior's list published under 25 U.S.C. 5131, EXCLUDING the Alaska Native villages, which Cedar holds as a separate class. It is the GOVERNMENT, not its companies: a tribal enterprise is a sub-hub of this entity, never a row of this class. It is NOT the whole federally recognized universe - 349 here plus 228 Alaska Native villages is 577, so quoting 349 as the federally recognized tribes understates it by 40%. NOT a state-recognized tribe.
statutory_basis: 25 U.S.C. 5131 (Federally Recognized Indian Tribe List Act); BIA annual list, FR doc 2026-01899, 91 FR 4102, 2026-01-30

label: Alaska Native village GOVERNMENT
definition: An Alaska Native village government - a federally recognized tribe that happens to be a village - carried as its own class because the split is geographic, not legal. It may own an enterprise directly (ANCSA ruling rule 3), and that enterprise is then an ordinary tribal enterprise. It is NOT an ANCSA corporation in either direction: a village government never owns an ANC (rule 2) and an ANC never owns the village government (rule 4). The two share a name and a place BY STATUTE, so a shared name is no evidence of one owner.
statutory_basis: 25 U.S.C. 5131 - the same Secretarial list as the class above

label: Native Hawaiian Organization (NHO)
definition: A Native Hawaiian community organization. 13 C.F.R. 124.110 requires an NHO to be a NON-PROFIT organization, and that requirement does the excluding. NOT a state agency - the Department of Hawaiian Home Lands is a State of Hawaii agency and was refused. NOT an LLC - Hoilina Ranch LLC was refused because an LLC cannot satisfy 124.110. An NHO-OWNED firm is a subsidiary, not an NHO.
statutory_basis: 13 C.F.R. 124.110 (SBA 8(a) definition of a Native Hawaiian Organization)
evidence_citation: docs/CEDAR_TAXONOMY.json layers.entity_class; docs/NHO_SPINE_MERGE_LOG.md; DOI Office of Native Hawaiian Relations roster (179 rows) + NHOA directory

label: Bureau of Indian Education school
definition: An elementary or secondary school in the Bureau of Indian Education directory, split by BIE's own bie_operation_type into Bureau-Operated and Tribally-Controlled. NOT tribally owned by default: 56 of the 185 are FEDERALLY operated and their blank parent is a RULING, not missing data. BIE's Navajo_Operation field is an administrative grouping, not ownership - trusting it books 35 schools to the Navajo Nation. Post-secondary institutions are NOT here; they belong to Tribal College or University.
statutory_basis: None cited in the repo. Membership is the BIE schools directory (bie.edu/schools ArcGIS feature service), not a statutory list.

label: ANCSA village corporation
definition: A for-profit corporation organised under ANCSA section 8, 43 U.S.C. 1607, for a named Alaska Native village. NOT the village government. NOT a subsidiary of its regional corporation - ANCSA ruling rule 5: they are two corporations with an overlapping shareholder base, and treating the regional as owner once moved $32.87B wrongly. AND TODAY NOT ONLY VILLAGE CORPORATIONS: the four ANCSA URBAN Corporations sit in this class because Cedar has no class for them (recorded gap ANCSA_URBAN_CORPORATION_HAS_NO_CLASS).
statutory_basis: ANCSA section 8, 43 U.S.C. 1607 (Urban Corporations named at 43 U.S.C. 1607(c))

label: Certified Native CDFI
definition: An institution carrying US Treasury CDFI Fund certification with the Native CDFI (Y/N) flag set. The certification is what qualifies it; nothing else does. NOT the same as Native Financial Institution, which is the broader Minneapolis Fed NAFI universe without Treasury certification. Both classes sit under the retired CDFI- handle prefix, so the prefix does not identify the class here.
statutory_basis: Treasury CDFI Fund certification (List of Currently Certified CDFIs; Total Number of Certified Native CDFIs as of July 16, 2026: 65). Underlying authority not cited in the repo.

label: State-recognized tribe
definition: A tribe recognised by a state and NOT by the United States. It has no ISDEAA relationship, no 25 U.S.C. 5131 listing, and it is NOT eligible under the SLFRF definition of Tribal government at 42 U.S.C. 802(g)(7). Pooling it with the federal class changes the recipient universe, which is why it is a separate class rather than an attribute.
statutory_basis: Defined by exclusion: NOT on the 25 U.S.C. 5131 list; NOT within 42 U.S.C. 802(g)(7). State recognition statutes vary and are not enumerated in the repo.

label: Intertribal organization
definition: An organisation whose MEMBERS are tribes. NOT owned by its member tribes - membership is recorded as member_of / affiliated_with, both of which sit in NEVER_OWNERSHIP, so no dollar rolls from the organisation up to a member. Distinguished from a self-governance consortium by function: an intertribal organization represents or convenes, it does not carry a member's ISDEAA self-governance compact in its own name.
example_name_1: Inter Tribal Council of Arizona, Inc.
statutory_basis: None. Not a statutory category. (ISDEAA tribal organization, 25 U.S.C. 5304(l), is a related but non-identical federal term used elsewhere in the repo.)
evidence_citation: docs/CEDAR_TAXONOMY.json layers.entity_class; docs/NHO_INTERTRIBAL_REGISTER_LOG.md; intertribal_orgs.csv (57 verified) + 989 membership rows

label: Individually Native-owned firm
definition: An ordinary firm - LLC, S-corp, sole proprietorship - whose OWNER is an individual Native person. Ruled into existence by the owner on 2026-08-07. It is NOT a tribal entity, NOT a false positive, and NOT excluded from the product; it simply never rolls up. parent_native_entity is permanently NULL and that blank is a RULING. Five of the 45 rulings read Not a Native entity - individually Native-owned firm, which refuses the TRIBAL LINK and AFFIRMS Native ownership; read literally as not Native it inverts the owner's meaning.
statutory_basis: None. An owner ruling, not a statutory or registry category.

label: Urban Indian Organization (UIO)
definition: A non-profit in the IHS Urban Indian Organization programme holding a Title V Indian Health Care Improvement Act contract with the Indian Health Service, serving Native people in an urban area. NOT tribally owned - it is owned by no tribe at all, and it serves people of many tribal affiliations by programme design, not by data gap. Serving a population is not being owned by it: serves_native_entities is never evidence of ownership. NOT resolvable by place name.
statutory_basis: Title V of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act - the IHS Title V contract is the qualifying instrument, per the IHS roster quoted in the repo

label: Tribal College or University (TCU)
definition: A tribally chartered or federally chartered post-secondary institution in the AIHEC roster (37 members: 34 regular, 1 associate, 2 developing). NOT its chartering tribe - the edge written is chartered_by, which is NOT in OWNERSHIP_BEARING, so a tribe chartering a college does not own it and the college's federal dollars are not the tribe's. NOT a BIE School: BIE post-secondary institutions belong to this roster, not that one.
statutory_basis: None cited in the repo. Membership is the AIHEC roster plus each institution's own chartering statement.

label: Native financial institution (non-certified)
definition: A Native-controlled financial institution in the Minneapolis Fed NAFI universe that is NOT a certified Native CDFI. The distinction from the CDFI class is Treasury certification and nothing else, and that single fact is the whole reason the two classes exist separately. Shares the retired CDFI- handle prefix with certified Native CDFIs, so the prefix cannot be used to tell them apart.
statutory_basis: None. Absence of Treasury CDFI certification is the defining fact; membership is the Minneapolis Fed nafi-map dataset (ncdfi / nmdi flags).

label: Self-governance consortium / compacting health organisation
definition: Cedar's stated definition is a consortium of tribes exercising self-governance authority jointly, and it is NOT an owner of its member tribes' activity and NOT owned by them. THE DEFINITION AND THE DATA HAVE DRIFTED APART: it was written when the class held 9 Alaska regional consortia, and the class now holds 29 rows including single-facility health corporations in CA, AZ, UT and OK (Winslow Indian Health Care Center, Chapa-De Indian Health Program, Feather River Tribal Health) that hold ISDEAA Title V compacts but are not obviously consortia of tribes. Treat the operative test as holds an ISDEAA self-governance compact in its own name, and read the row before relying on the class.
statutory_basis: ISDEAA self-governance compacts (IHS Title V compact register, 147 holders). Specific USC section not cited in the repo for this class.

label: Constituent band of a federally recognized tribe
definition: A constituent band, community or pueblo sitting inside an umbrella tribal government that is itself the federally listed entity. NOT a subsidiary: constituent_band_of sits in GOVERNMENTAL_RELATIONSHIPS and therefore in NEVER_OWNERSHIP, so a band's contracts are not the umbrella's - mapping a flat parent column wholesale would have rolled 22 of these into their umbrellas. Cedar's taxonomy says such a band is itself named on the federal list; the register contradicts that on 21 of 22 rows (see FINDINGS).
example_name_2: Te-Moak Tribe of Western Shoshone Indians of Nevada - Battle Mountain Band
statutory_basis: Parenthetical naming on the 25 U.S.C. 5131 list is the implied basis (cf. 42 U.S.C. 802(g)(7), including parenthetically), but the register marks 21 of 22 rows OUT_OF_SCOPE_BY_CONSTRUCTION.

label: ANCSA regional corporation
definition: One of the in-state for-profit corporations organised under ANCSA section 7, 43 U.S.C. 1606. NOT the owner of the village corporations in its region (ANCSA ruling rule 5) and NOT a place: associated_with_region is geography, and treating it as ownership once moved $32.87B wrongly. Cedar holds 12; ANCSA's thirteenth region is the out-of-state region and is not held here.

label: ANCSA group corporation
definition: A corporation organised for a Native GROUP under ANCSA rather than for a village. NOT a village corporation, though it shares the retired ANVC- handle prefix, which is the second place in Cedar where the prefix does not identify the class. Like the village corporations it is a for-profit ANCSA corporation, and it is never owned by, and never owns, a tribal government.
statutory_basis: Named at 43 U.S.C. 1607(c) (ANCSA section 8(c), which applies 43 U.S.C. 1606(g),(h),(o) identically to Village, Urban and Group Corporations)

label: Constituent group inside a state-recognized tribe
definition: Cedar's stated definition is a constituent group inside a state-recognized tribe, NOT federally recognized and NOT a subsidiary. The class holds only three rows and the definition does not describe all of them: the two Schaghticoke entities (CT) fit, but Trenton Indian Service Area (ND) carries the handle CNSS-TURTLM-TR and is a service area associated with the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, which is FEDERALLY recognized. Read the row; do not infer state recognition of the parent from the class name.
statutory_basis: None. Defined by exclusion from federal recognition.

label: Native nonprofit (501(c)(3))
definition: A nonprofit corporation that is Native-led and registered with the IRS, and that is not itself a tribal government, ANC, NHO or other entity class Cedar already holds. Membership requires BOTH legs: a third-party directory of Native-led organizations lists it, and the IRS Business Master File carries its EIN. It is NOT any nonprofit serving Native people - a municipal housing authority serving a reservation is not a Native nonprofit, which is the same error that once attributed $1.13B of Omaha city housing money to the Omaha Tribe.
statutory_basis: 26 U.S.C. 501(c)(3) for the registration leg; Native-led status has no statutory register
evidence_citation: givenative.org directory + IRS EO BMF (bmf_full_2026-08-12); 253 of 257 verified present in the BMF on 2026-09-04
